name: Long-lived supercell
description: Tighter thresholds than the generic supercell preset — flags environments where individual cells can persist for hours. WFO Louisville tip sheet: 0-8 km shear > 52 kt (BRNSHR > 80-100 m²/s²) and large CAPE. Modern effective-layer composites (EBWD, ESRH) are used here as the operational stand-ins for BRNSHR. Starting point — tune across cycles.
